normalized.prelim_summary: This 2005 Ford GT, previously owned by Doug DeMuro, is one of the most thoroughly documented examples available, with full factory paperwork, service history, and extensive included memorabilia. It has minor cosmetic flaws and some performance modifications (tune, pulley) that could affect emissions compliance in certain states. With only two owners and strong provenance, it's a highly desirable example for collectors despite its light modifications.

documentation.why: VIN, Carfax report, full build book, order form, window stickers, detailed service logs with mileage/dates, and extensive provenance from Doug DeMuro himself.

condition.why: Detailed service records show consistent maintenance (tires, fluids, brakes), but seller discloses specific flaws: PPF marks, chips, clearcoat failure on one wheel, seat wear, and worn A-arm bushings requiring replacement.

spec.why: Rare limited-production American supercar, 6-speed manual, three-option build with BBS wheels and painted stripes/calipers, plus celebrity/journalist provenance and designer signature.
